title: List the full names and total expenses of members who hold a leadership pos
question: List the full names and total expenses of members who hold a leadership position (President, Vice President, or Treasurer) and whose associated events have at least one budget category with remaining funds greater than 20 dollars.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036", SUM(T2."XCL_020") AS total_expenses
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_022"
WHERE T1."XCL_038" IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Treasurer')
  AND T1."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT T2."XCL_022"
    FROM expense AS T2
    INNER JOIN budget AS T3 ON T2."XCL_023" = T3."XCL_003"
    INNER JOIN event AS T4 ON T3."XCL_009" = T4."XCL_010"
    WHERE T3."XCL_006" > 20
  )
GROUP BY T1."XCL_034", T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036"
